content.title: WQD
content.text: World Quantum Day 2026: call for action! FEBRUARY 11, 2026 Following the closing of the International Year of Quantum Science and Technology (IYQ 2025) a few weeks ago, the World Quantum Day – 14 April (WQD) continues to celebrate quantum science and technology around the world, as usual on the days and weeks around 14 April. Submit WQD your event now!The World Quantum Day is a decentralised and bottom-up initiative, inviting all scientists, engineers, educators, communicators, entrepreneurs, technologists, historians, philosophers, artists, museologists, producers, etc., and their organisations, to develop their own activities, such as scientific meetings, outreach talks, exhibitions, lab tours, panel discussions, interviews, artistic creations, etc., to celebrate quantum science and technology around the World.By creating and submitting your event, you can make your city a Quantum City 2026, and generate your Quantum City logo. In 2025 there were more than 300 Quantum Cities around the World!You can find examples from past World Quantum Day events, as well as of upcoming and ongoing events, in the World Quantum Day website.Submit your event at: https://worldquantumday.org/submit-an-event/Follow @worldquantumday on Bluesky, Instagram, LinkedIn, Threads, YouTube.Use the hashtags: #WorldQuantumDay #QuantumCityJoin us in celebrating the World Quantum Day on, and around, 14 April 2026!Let's quantum!The World Quantum Day Teamhttps://worldquantumday.org/
